fields.title: 1. 13D/A No. 82 — What Was Disclosed
fields.md:
Source: [13D/A No. 82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml) (event date 2026-11-16 · signed 2026-11-17) · [Form 4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465872/xslF345X06/ownership.xml) (signed 2026-11-17).

| Transaction (2026-11-16) | Shares | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Class A → Class B conversion | 6,150 Class A shares → 9,225,000 Class B shares | 1:1,500 (formula 6,150 × 1,500) |
| Gift — Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation | 3,690,000 Class B shares | Form 4 code G (gift), price $0 |
| Gift — Sherwood Foundation | 1,845,000 Class B shares | Same |
| Gift — Howard G. Buffett Foundation | 1,845,000 Class B shares | Same |
| Gift — NoVo Foundation | 1,845,000 Class B shares | Same |

Source: the two original filings above. Total gifts of 9,225,000 shares = number of shares converted (formula 3,690,000 + 1,845,000 × 3).

- Holdings after the transactions (13D/A No. 82 cover page): 182,140 Class A shares (38.4% of Class A) · 1,162 Class B shares (below 0.01%) · sole voting and dispositive power over all, shared 0 · voting power 29.6% · economic interest 12.9% (source: [No. 82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
- What the filing does not give: the value at the time of the gifts. Approximated with the 2026-11-16 Class B closing price, it is about $5.47 billion (estimate — formula 9,225,000 × 592.85; closing price from [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
- On the same day, 'Thanksgiving Message from Warren Buffett' (2026-11-16) was posted on the Berkshire website (source: [2026 press release list](https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/news/2026news.html)). This probe could not read the PDF text — since statements in the letter are not judgment material in the first place (Rule 1), recording milestone candidates is also deferred to the next issue.

### Reproducing the Cover-Page Numbers (Cross-Check)
- Class A 38.4%: subtracting this conversion's 6,150 shares from the 480,476 Class A shares on the 10-Q cover (2026-10-28) gives 474,326 shares → 182,140 ÷ 474,326 = 38.4% (formula; cover page from the [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm)). Other conversions between 10/28 and 11/16 could not be reflected (estimate).
- Economic interest 12.9%: 182,140 ÷ 1,416,346 Class A-equivalent shares (10-Q cover) = 12.86% (formula) — conversion does not change the total Class A-equivalent count.
- Voting power 29.6%: one Class B share carries 1/10,000 of the voting power of a Class A share (definition — state.definitions.buffett_stake). 1,413,030,594 Class B shares (formula 1,403,805,594 + 9,225,000) ÷ 10,000 = 141,303 votes + 474,326 Class A votes = 615,629 votes → 182,140 ÷ 615,629 = 29.6% (formula).
